items.summary: Financial recommendation: freeze new monetization experiments, tooling, and discretionary spend this cycle. Continue only existing bounded workstreams through their measurement gates. Amazon supports only an aggregate $4.92 commission claim for 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, and 6 shipped items; all $4.92 is unattributed, so site revenue, contribution margin, ROI, CAC, payback, profitability, and forecasts are unsupported. AI usage cost is $759.78 from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-23 across 4,529 calls and 39 instrumented sites, but infrastructure, domain, labor, and other direct costs are unavailable. No budget limits are supplied: monthly spend, fixed costs, marketing budget, and revenue floor are blank. Maintain SearchWoot private and do not authorize new queue actions or financial commitments.

Attribution quality is insufficient for investment decisions: Amazon reports 18 mapped tracking rows plus one aggregate 'other' row containing all 28 orders, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission. Minimum measurement needed for site-level claims is a reconciled export linking each outbound affiliate click, registered tracking ID, order, shipped item, commission, and reporting date to site/content identifiers. Contribution margin additionally requires infrastructure, domain, payment/platform, labor, and incremental experiment costs by site and period. Cost-to-learn requires experiment-level incremental cost and attributable conversion or commission outcomes; neither is calculable from the brief. Treat impressions, clicks, sessions, conversions, AI calls, and CRO opportunity scores as activity or learning signals, not revenue evidence.

Freeze new monetization experiments, tooling, and discretionary spend this cycle. The reported commission remains aggregate and unattributed; site revenue, margin, ROI, CAC, payback, profitability, and forecasts remain unsupported.
